DECLARATION OF LOCAL CONTENT BY LOCAL SUPPLIER

Subject: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India)

References: Preference to Make in India including counter offering will be as per the public Procurement (Preference to Make in India, Order 2017, Policy No P-45021/2/2017-PP(BE-II) dated 16 Sep 2020 and P-45021/102/2019-(BE-II)-Part(1)(E-50310) dated 04 Mar 2021.

1. We hereby declare that with reference to above subject and references, we M/s   are a (Choose any one as applicable)

(a) "Class-I local supplier" meeting the requirement of minimum local content equal to 50% (fifty percent) or more defined in the above government notification for the goods and services.

(OR)

(b) "Class-II local Supplier" meeting the requirement of local content 20% to less than 50% (Fifty percent) defined in the above government notification for the goods and services.

(OR)

(c) Non Local Supplier (If not belonging to Class-I & Class-II)

for the product / item as specified in GeM Bid No   dated  .

2. We further certify that the above declaration is made in compliance with Govt orders issued from time to time and specifically vide Govt of India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, OM No.P-45021/102/2019-BE-II-Part(1)(E-50310) dated 04 Mar 2021 wherein Services such as Transportation, Insurance, Installation, Commissioning, Training and after Sales Service Support like AMC/CMC etc have not been counted towards calculations of % of local content while classifying the suppliers as Class-I or Class-II.

3. We also understand that the false declarations will be in breach of the code of Integrity under rule 175(1)(i)(h) of the General Financial Rules for which we (bidders & our successors) can be debarred for up to two years as per Rule 151 (iii) of the General Financial Rules along with such other actions as may be permissible under law.

Authorised Signature M/s
